title: Non-blocking follow-ups from backend-trade-apgar PR #220 review
description: Non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's review of PR #220 (backend-trade-apgar), recorded here per CLAUDE.md's convention so they aren't lost once the PR merges.

checklist.step: backend/app/api/routers/portfolio.py:776's POST /api/portfolio/trade-apgar handler is named `get_trade_apgar`, a `get_`-prefixed function name attached to a `@router.post` -- mismatches this file's own verb/method-matching convention (`add_position`/`delete_position`/`get_risk`, etc.) and the endpoint's own declared `operation_id="score_trade_apgar"`. No behavior impact (FastAPI dispatches on the decorator/operation_id, not the Python function name), but rename to something like `score_trade_apgar` (matching the operation_id) to avoid misleading a future reader grepping for `def get_` to find read-only handlers.
